scenicChapters.title: Kancamagus Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 14 km. 590 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: White Mountain Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: 29 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

white-mountain-trail.story: 109 km round from Woodstock - plan on about 1 h 45 of riding. The stops in between: Franconia Notch, Crawford Notch and North Conway. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-the-ratkov-rozhnov-a-estate-dubki.story: A 133 km round trip from Lomonosov - roughly 2 h 25 in the saddle. On the way it passes Zelenogorsky, The Village of Olgino, Moskovskaya Road and back through The Village of Olgino. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
